parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by a field of force.

parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem: State the type of field, or fields, that will give rise to a force acting on

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: a charged particle moving at an angle to the field or fields.

parts.label: (c)
parts.part_stem:
An electron, mass $m$ and charge $-q$, is moving at speed $v$ in a vacuum. It enters a region of uniform magnetic field of flux density $B$, as shown in Fig. 7.1.
{{figure:figure_7_1}}
Fig. 7.1
Initially, the electron is moving at right-angles to the direction of the magnetic field.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Explain why the path of the electron in the magnetic field is the arc of a circle.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Derive an expression, in terms of the radius $r$ of the path, for the linear momentum of the electron. Show your working.
